facts.fact: The Supabase MCP server documentation page was last updated on November 11, 2026.
Tool feature groups that the connection supports are enabled by default, except the Storage group.
facts.quote: Groups that your connection supports are enabled by default, except Storage.

facts.fact: The Storage feature group of the Supabase MCP server is disabled by default.
The run_notebook tool can run up to 50 query cells in a notebook, or only selected cells.
facts.quote: Run up to 50 query cells in a notebook, or only selected cells

facts.fact: If no project is selected when scoping the Supabase MCP server, all projects are accessible through it.
facts.quote: If no project is selected, all projects will be accessible.

facts.fact: The Feedback tools are disabled when the MCP server runs in read-only mode (the read_only parameter).
The Branching tool group of the Supabase MCP server is labeled experimental.
The default MCP server URL enables the feature groups docs, account, database, debugging, development, functions, branching, feedback, and notebooks.
Account cost tools get_cost and confirm_cost apply to tools that use the legacy cost confirmation workflow.
facts.quote: Cost information for tools that use the [legacy cost confirmation workflow]

facts.fact: The submit_feedback tool returns a token, which is then used with delete_feedback to delete that feedback.
facts.quote: Delete feedback using the token returned by `submit_feedback`

facts.fact: During sign-in for the MCP client, the user should choose the organization that contains the project they want to work with.
facts.quote: Be sure to choose the organization that contains the project you wish to work with.
